d:
It has been two years since she announced on FANBOX that she was quitting as a manga artist and leaving the scene.
I was fortunate enough to own all the books she produced—including the bonus items—and had successfully saved the FANBOX data before it was deleted.
However, I was foolish enough to neglect making a backup.
As a result of that negligence, all the data was lost when my hard drive failed!

There is little hope of her returning, so I cannot expect another chance to get my hands on the data.
If anyone possesses the FANBOX data (including the C103 content), would you please help a pitiful soul like me?

For the record, the file I’ve uploaded here is the best version I could create by processing scans of my personal physical copies to remove the censorship edits. (Compared to the official digital editions, there were fewer censored areas, so I was able to remove them quite successfully.)
The image quality isn't perfect, but I hope this reaches someone willing to lend a helping hand.
